One-plug umbilical

Blue Fiberon PET-GF15 plug and socket in a black enclosure receiver. A packed insulated entry feeds curved tube guides and a straight mating nose. The integral open-guard candidate fits the counter envelope; rounded wings leave 0.519 mm nominal clearance to a broad flat wall. Physical protection and grip are unqualified.

View
AMachine side

Loading geometry…

Flush in back-top: a 47.0 x 44.6 face on a 2.5 mm side ledge, held from inside by two snap leaves.

BPlug

Loading geometry…

Ø34 rear body, 98 mm long: 15 mm fabric cuff, 45 mm curved transition and 38 mm straight nose. One blue key retains the four tubes.

CPlugged in

Loading geometry…

The plug runs 7.7 mm into the 34 mm cup before a stub reaches its hole. The bars meet face to face.

DRelease

Loading geometry…

FLAVOR-B over DRAIN. Each union floats 1.83 mm: a pull drags it forward until its collet lands on the floor's back face and lets go. Side shows the cut.

EThrough the counter

Loading geometry…

The Ø34 rigid boot in the 1⅜″ countertop hole: 0.465 mm nominal radial clearance. The loose foam and braid need compression during passage.

FBoot materials

Loading geometry…

The cut follows the soda tube. Foam continues into the first half of its curved guide; the fabric tucks 15 mm into the cuff. A chamfered shoulder marks the seated depth, with 64 mm of boot outside the port.

GGuarded candidate

Loading geometry…

Four integral open fences clear the unions and fit Ø34 mm. R0.5 edges leave 0.519 mm nominal clearance ahead of the tubes against a broad flat surface. Narrow corners can enter the gaps; this is CAD only.

HGuarded mating

Loading geometry…

The matching socket is 2.4 mm wider with four guard channels. No extra part, moving mechanism or wet joint. The current rigid approach envelope is 126.3 mm; printability, stiffness and handling remain unqualified.

IGuard through counter

Loading geometry…

The complete guarded rigid boot remains Ø34 mm in the Ø34.93 mm hole. Its fences extend 2 mm beyond the longest tube. Foam/braid passage still needs handling.

JMachine-side plate

The slicer's plate: socket on its flats, retainer, wall coupon roof-down. One pause for the socket's bars.

KPlug-side plate

Saved coupling trial without the guided boot: the plug upside down on its top flat and the key on end. One pause for the plug's bars.
